name: Technical Trader
summary: This EA uses a dual moving average crossover combined with a statistical support/resistance detection mechanism to generate buy and sell signals. It scans historical close prices to find levels where price has touched multiple times (resistance/support clusters) and enters trades when price is near these cluster levels and the MAs confirm trend direction. Positions are managed with fixed stop loss and take profit, executing only on new bars.
summary_zh: 该EA使用双均线交叉结合统计支撑/阻力检测机制来产生买卖信号。它扫描历史收盘价寻找价格多次触及的聚类水平（支撑/阻力），当价格接近这些聚类且均线确认趋势方向时入场。采用固定止损止盈管理仓位，仅在新K线形成时执行交易。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于双移动平均线交叉与价格聚类支撑/阻力位的结合。入场条件为：买入需短期MA(25)大于长期MA(30)且当前ask价格接近并高于阻力聚类水平（距离小于0.0005）；卖出需短期MA小于长期MA且当前bid价格接近并低于支撑聚类水平。出场条件完全依赖固定止损和止盈，没有移动止损或条件出场机制。仓位管理使用品种最小交易手数，没有加仓或减仓逻辑。资金管理方面，代码尝试检查可用保证金是否充足，但存在严重逻辑错误——margin变量未初始化就与free_margin比较，导致条件判断形同虚设。此外，0.0005的硬编码阈值对不同品种（如XAUUSD）完全不适用，买入单的magic number使用了硬编码15489而非输入参数EA_Magic，止损止盈在5/3位小数品种上乘以10的处理也可能不够准确。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept combines dual moving average crossover with a price cluster-based support/resistance detection mechanism. Entry conditions require: for buys, the short-period MA(25) must be above the long-period MA(30) and the current ask price must be near and above a resistance cluster level (within 0.0005); for sells, the short MA must be below the long MA and the current bid price must be near and below a support cluster level. Exit conditions rely entirely on fixed stop loss and take profit with no trailing stop or conditional exit logic. Position sizing uses the symbol's minimum lot size with no scaling or position accumulation logic. Money management attempts to check free margin but contains a critical bug—the margin variable is used uninitialized in the comparison, making the check effectively meaningless. Additionally, the hardcoded 0.0005 threshold is completely inappropriate for instruments like XAUUSD, the buy order uses a hardcoded magic number 15489 instead of the input parameter EA_Magic, and the 5/3 digit multiplier for SL/TP may not handle all broker configurations correctly.

parameters.name: resistance
parameters.description: 阻力/支撑聚类计数阈值

pros: 使用价格聚类统计方法识别支撑阻力位，思路有一定创新性
仅在新K线形成时执行交易逻辑，避免高频重复信号
有基础的止损止盈保护机制
对5/3位小数品种进行了点值适配处理
包含数据同步检查逻辑，增强初始化健壮性
pros_en: Uses a statistical price clustering method to identify support/resistance levels, which is conceptually innovative
Only executes trading logic on new bar formation, avoiding high-frequency duplicate signals
Has basic stop loss and take profit protection mechanism in place
Includes point value adaptation for 5/3 digit brokers
Contains data synchronization check logic during initialization for robustness
cons: margin变量未初始化即使用，资金管理检查完全失效，可能导致保证金不足时仍然下单
买入订单使用硬编码magic number 15489而非输入参数EA_Magic，与卖出订单不一致
0.0005的价格距离阈值硬编码，对XAUUSD等大点值品种完全不可用
支撑阻力扫描使用0.001步长循环，性能极差且精度不适用于所有品种
PositionSelect只检查单品种单仓位，无法处理多仓位或对冲账户
ORDER_FILLING_FOK硬编码，部分经纪商不支持该成交类型
statParam结构体定义但从未使用，属于冗余代码
cons_en: The margin variable is used uninitialized, making the money management check completely ineffective and potentially allowing trades with insufficient margin
Buy orders use hardcoded magic number 15489 instead of the input parameter EA_Magic, creating inconsistency with sell orders
The 0.0005 price proximity threshold is hardcoded and completely unusable for high-value instruments like XAUUSD
The support/resistance scanning uses a 0.001 step loop which is extremely inefficient and the precision is inappropriate for all instruments
PositionSelect only checks for a single position per symbol, unable to handle multiple positions or hedging accounts
ORDER_FILLING_FOK is hardcoded but not supported by all brokers, which will cause order rejection
The statParam struct is defined but never used, representing dead code
improvements: 修复margin变量初始化问题，使用OrderCalcMargin正确计算所需保证金后再比较
将硬编码的价格距离阈值改为基于ATR或品种点值的自适应参数，适配所有品种
统一买卖订单的magic number使用EA_Magic输入参数，移除硬编码值
优化支撑阻力扫描算法，避免O(n²)循环，改用直方图统计或排序后聚类方法
添加成交类型自动检测逻辑，根据经纪商支持的填充模式选择合适的ORDER_FILLING
improvements_en: Fix the margin variable initialization issue by using OrderCalcMargin to properly calculate required margin before comparison
Replace the hardcoded price proximity threshold with an ATR-based or tick-value-adaptive parameter to work across all instruments
Unify buy and sell order magic numbers to use the EA_Magic input parameter, removing hardcoded values
Optimize the support/resistance scanning algorithm to avoid O(n²) loops, using histogram statistics or sorted clustering instead
Add automatic fill mode detection logic to select the appropriate ORDER_FILLING based on broker-supported modes

risk_points: margin变量未初始化导致资金管理检查失效，可能在保证金不足时下单
硬编码的价格距离阈值对非外汇品种无效，可能产生错误信号
买卖订单magic number不一致导致仓位管理混乱，可能无法正确识别EA持有的仓位
risk_points_en: Uninitialized margin variable makes money management check ineffective, potentially placing trades with insufficient margin
Hardcoded price proximity threshold is invalid for non-forex instruments, potentially generating incorrect signals
Inconsistent magic numbers between buy and sell orders cause position management confusion, potentially failing to identify EA-held positions
